about: Extra kinds (people, pets, livestock, nothing alive; COCO 2017, extra/coco-kinds on pub/data-alachua) for the pocket models: the original model's vectors on every row, and the shipping int8 file (onnx/vision.int8-per-channel.onnx) through onnxruntime-web 1.30.0's WASM build on the test rows only (four single-thread processes). One machine at a time, 39M first. Replaces run/lab/extra-coco, which never ran.
